MLBB StarLight: price, rewards and every skin by month

In November 2026 it is Kalea "Tideborn Sailor" for 300 Diamonds. Here are all 120 skins since 2016 and what else the pass gives.

In this story

  1. How much it costs
  2. What you get besides the skin
  3. How to get a skin from a past month
  4. Skins of 2026
  5. Every skin since 2016
  6. Annual StarLight skins
All news
In this story
How much it costsWhat you get besides the skinHow to get a skin from a past monthSkins of 2026Every skin since 2016Annual StarLight skins

In brief

  • StarLight costs 300 Diamonds a month, the Plus version 750.
  • The November 2026 skin is Kalea "Tideborn Sailor". The wiki list has Suyou "Frostblade Duelist" for December; MOONTON has not confirmed it yet.
  • Besides the skin, members get +10 Protection Points for every ranked loss and access to the StarLight Shop.
  • Since December 2016 there have been 120 skins. 108 of the 133 heroes got one, while 25 heroes, Marcel and Hirara among them, never have.

StarLight is a paid pass for one month. It opens on the 1st at 00:00 server time and gives the skin of the month at once. The other rewards come over 60 levels that grow with matches and tasks. At the end of the month the skin leaves the pass page, and tasks, levels and the shop reset.

How much it costs

StarLight prices in November 2026
ItemPriceWho needs it
StarLight300 DiamondsAnyone who wants the skin of the month and the perks
StarLight Plus750 DiamondsLate buyers: 15 levels at once
Painted version of the skin100 DiamondsMembers of that month only
StarLight Chest10 Diamonds a drawUp to 50 draws a month, random rewards

Prices from the MOONTON perks video and the timesaver.gg breakdown of 31 October 2026. Check the price in the game before buying.

Plus costs 450 Diamonds more. In return it gives 1,500 StarLight points, which is 15 levels at once, and 10% more points for the rest of the month. If you play almost every day, level 60 is reachable with the regular pass: for the first three weeks tasks open up to 18 levels a week, and the last week has no cap. Plus only pays off if you start near the end of the month.

What you get besides the skin

  • +10 Protection Points for every ranked loss.
  • 10% more EXP, 5% more Battle Points and 30% more Mastery Points per match.
  • Up to 200 friends.
  • An avatar border, chat frame, battle emotes and spawn, recall and elimination effects in the month’s theme.
  • Access to the StarLight Shop, where fragments buy skins from past months.

If you are climbing ranks

The Protection Points matter more than the skin. The star protection bar fills faster, so a losing streak costs fewer stars. Our ranks guide explains how protection and stars work.

Guide Mobile Legends ranks in order Every rank, star counts, star protection and the road to Mythic

How to get a skin from a past month

Through the StarLight Shop. Since November 2026 MOONTON has added returning skins and Returning StarLight Packs there. According to GamingOnPhone, a regular old skin costs 3,000 StarLight Fragments and an Annual StarLight skin 5,000. A month of the pass brings from about 920 to 1,120 fragments, so one skin takes roughly three months. The exchange is open only to players who hold the pass in the current month.

Skins of 2026

December comes from the wiki list and leaks. MOONTON shows the skin of the month in the last days before it, usually in a perks video.

If the leak is right, this will be Suyou’s first StarLight skin. Pass skins go most often to fighters (33 of 120), mages (25) and marksmen (24). There have been 22 assassins, 14 tanks and only 2 supports.

Every skin since 2016

12 heroes have two pass skins: Gusion, Irithel, Clint, Layla, Martis, Miya, Moskov, Saber, Freya, Hanabi, Harley and Hayabusa. 25 have none: Badang, Baxia, Barats, Gloo, Johnson, Julian, Diggie, Carmilla, Lolita, Lukas, Marcel, Mathilda, Minotaur, Rafaela, Sora, Suyou, Terizla, Uranus, Faramis, Floryn, Khaleed, Hylos, Hirara, Chip and Estes.

The first pass skin came out in December 2016: Saber "Force Warrior".

Annual StarLight skins

Once a year, at the StarLight Fest, a separate skin of a higher rarity came out. It was not part of the regular monthly pass, and such skins now return to the StarLight Shop for 5,000 fragments.

FAQ

How much is StarLight in MLBB?

300 Diamonds a month. StarLight Plus costs 750 Diamonds and gives 15 pass levels at once.

What is the December 2026 StarLight skin?

The wiki list and leaks name Suyou "Frostblade Duelist". MOONTON confirms the skin of the month in the last days before it.

When does a new StarLight start?

On the 1st of every month at 00:00 server time. Tasks, levels and the StarLight Shop reset at the same moment.

Can I get a skin from a past month?

Yes, in the StarLight Shop for 3,000 fragments, or 5,000 for a Fest skin. The exchange needs the pass in the current month.

Which heroes have two StarLight skins?

12 heroes: Gusion, Irithel, Clint, Layla, Martis, Miya, Moskov, Saber, Freya, Hanabi, Harley and Hayabusa.
